newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay bourse carry forward trades - Aug 2.
newsitem.headline: Bombay bourse carry forward trades - Aug 2.

text.p: The following is the trade data for the top stocks at the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) for the carry-forward or "badla" account on Saturday at the close.
SCRIP HAWALA Last Badla AVG AVG VOL VAL
RATE Badla Yield BADLA YIELD QTY (million)
The "badla" is interest rate for carry-forward trades. These are arrived through unique transactions which takes into account oversold and overbought positions and money supply.
The average badla charges worked out to 16.75 percent on an annualised basis against 18.75 percent in the previous carry forward account ended July 26. --Bombay Newsroom +91-22-265-9000
